notes: Protocol v2.0.0 of the NEW, additive, read-only study ISSUE53_EXEC_SHADOW. It does not modify PF_EDGE_STRICT_V1 or paper_config.json (pinned below by sha256). PROSPECTIVE EVIDENCE exists only as SEALED PRE-TIP ledger entries: a read-only job evaluates each game after the T-60 archive cutoff and before tip, and persists an immutable, independently timestamped seal (exec-shadow-seals branch) containing the TRADE/NO_TRADE decision, reasons, inputs and hashes. Post-game research JOINS settlements to the sealed ledger and never recomputes or changes a selection. A missing, late, unverifiable or protocol-mismatched seal is NO_DATA / uncounted, never prospective. Reconstruction from archives after the fact (study53 without a seal) is RETROSPECTIVE and descriptive, always. Changing any value means a new version and a new later start.

base_protocol.note: quality gates (two-sided, active, top size, spread <= 0.15, price 0.03-0.97, no BLOCK gate), the fee multiplier and the thesis definitions are read from the pinned base file, not re-declared. A test fails if the base file's digest changes.

checkpoint.max_quote_age_note: age of the board at the checkpoint (checkpoint - board_observed_utc); 900 s is the existing CLOSING_MAX_AGE_S constant of the paper system, chosen before any result was scored here and not tuned. The base 1800 s board-age gate also still applies.
checkpoint.board_after_checkpoint: NO_TRADE (a board observed after the checkpoint is never used)
checkpoint.missing_or_stale_board: NO_TRADE for the whole game (reason recorded per game); never replaced by another horizon, never backfilled
checkpoint.board_rule: the board of a game is the latest capture tick OBSERVED at or before the checkpoint; it must also be COMMITTED to the capture branch at or before the checkpoint (git commit time). If it is not, the game is NO_TRADE. No fallback to an earlier archived tick, no grace window (owner decision 2026-10-21).
checkpoint.forecast_rule: player and game forecasts must be generated, self-archived AND committed to projection-data at or before the checkpoint; the engine's as-of rule (generated <= board time) is unchanged

execution.fee_rounding: whole-order, round-up-to-cent taker fee (nba_edge.kalshi.fees) used BOTH for the entry decision (ev_net_exec) and for settlement
execution.dnp_policy: participation-aware: p_model prices the DNP leg at the decision-time mid; settlement values a DNP at the authoritative Kalshi scalar when archived, otherwise the LAST_VALID mid (flagged modeled_last_valid_mid); never a fee-free void
execution.insufficient_displayed_depth: the candidate is blocked (INSUFFICIENT_DEPTH) -> PASS / NO_TRADE; no partial fill is imagined and nothing is filled beyond the displayed top-of-book size

PF_EDGE_STRICT_T60_EXEC_V1.rule: one fixed pretip checkpoint per game; PASS-only; one highest-net-EV contract per thesis; global chronological exposure ledger

PF_EDGE_STRICT_T60_EXEC_JRM_V1.differs_only_in: p_play and the conditional stat probabilities of players covered by an ELIGIBLE, matched, pre-tip JRM snapshot (minutes/participation inputs and their downstream projection); everything else (contract, side, price, size, entry time, costs, filters, exposure order, matchup context, game-level projections) is identical
PF_EDGE_STRICT_T60_EXEC_JRM_V1.downstream: p_cond' = P(X >= k / r) from the archived frozen pmf with r = minutes_given_play_jrm / frozen_published.minutes_given_play_after_gate (the paper engine's own mean-scale convention, probability.p_ge(scale=r)); p_play' = p_play_jrm; p_model' = p_play' * p_cond' + (1 - p_play') * m_side. Rates, usage redistribution and gate status are NOT re-estimated: this is an archive-only approximation, labelled as such in every output

exposure.scope: ONE global chronological ledger across all checkpoints and games (caps are never reset between horizon snapshots or runs); positions are admitted in decision-instant order, within an instant by descending ev_net_exec; a thesis already held can never be entered again

jrm_matching.rules_owner: PR chmoses98/nba-edge-finder#45 (minutes_rebuild/archive_rules.py F1-F5). Reused through the register, not re-implemented: the eligibility verdict is the register's.
required: register row eligible_for_prospective_scoring == true AND the game in games_eligible
file sha256 equals the register / MANIFEST sha256 (changed-tree / edited file -> reject)
archived_utc AND branch_commit_utc at least 5 minutes before the decision instant (checkpoint) and before tip (post-tip / late -> reject)
feed_generated_utc equals the V1 decision's forecast_generated_utc (same feed, else NO_MATCH)
version v2, allocation recorded as uniform, row pregame == true
reject_always: any snapshot without a register row

prospective_gate.starter_guard: established rotation players (JRM rank <= 8, p_jrm >= 0.5): MAE(JRM) - MAE(frozen) CI upper bound < +0.25 min
prospective_gate.owner: PR #45 evaluate_prospective.py (not recomputed or relaxed here; this study only tracks the game count)

jrm_matching.promotion: none: no model promotion, no activation of JRM or PR #47 is possible from this study

evidence.value_validation_requires: n_decisions >= 200 AND n_games >= 40 AND lower 95% bound of ROI > 0 under BOTH game-clustered and player-game-clustered bootstraps
evidence.language: never 'edge', 'profitable' or 'validated' below the minimums; first-week results are descriptive only

no_tuning: No threshold above was chosen or changed after looking at 2026-10-20 / 2026-10-21 results. Any optimisation is a distinct FUTURE experiment with its own preregistration, prospective start and multiple-testing discipline.

supersedes.reason: Owner review of PR #54 (2026-10-21T23:33Z): a study run AFTER a game can reconstruct a portfolio from upstream pre-tip timestamps but cannot prove that the #53 choices were sealed before tip. v1.1.0 is kept byte-identical for the record; no prospective result was ever collected under it (its start 2026-10-22T06:00Z passed with no sealing path); NOTHING computed under v1.x counts as prospective.
supersedes.unchanged: strategy ids, every numeric selection rule, the strict T-60 archive cutoff (board and forecast observed/generated AND committed at/before the checkpoint; no grace window, no later horizon, no fallback to an earlier tick)

sealing.earliest_note: capture ticks reach the capture branch ~3.4 min after observation (192-211 s measured on opening night); the sealer waits until the cut-off history is stable
sealing.deadline_note: a seal must be committed to the ledger branch at least 10 minutes before tip; later = LATE (uncounted)
sealing.missed_marker: a game with no seal after its window is recorded as MISSED (uncounted, alert); never sealed late as if on time
counted_iff: seal verifies (sha256 of body and of the candidate file)
seal.protocol_sha256 equals this file's sha256 and seal.study_version == 2.0.0
the seal commit's INDEPENDENT commit time on the ledger branch is >= seal.computed_utc - 120 s (not backdated) and <= tip - deadline_before_tip_s
seal.code_sha is reachable from the default branch and the protocol file's commit on the default branch precedes prospective_start_utc
independent archive clocks were supplied and the board/forecast commit times were recorded in the seal
never: recompute a sealed selection from later archive state
count a seal produced by a branch/PR workflow run
overwrite, edit or delete a seal
sealing.cadence: cron every 5 minutes during game hours (cheap plan step; the seal step runs only when a window is open, ~9 attempts per 44-minute window), workflow_dispatch fallback, concurrency-serialised, idempotent per game

jrm_exact.engine: PR #45 opt-in PF_NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE=jrm (nba.project.project_slate(minutes_engine='jrm')), merged only inside the throw-away runner checkout at a pinned SHA
jrm_exact.input_rule: frozen and JRM are computed in ONE process from the same slate, availability observations, calibration and clock; the market board is the same
jrm_exact.label: exact_jrm_dry_run
jrm_exact.approximation_label: archive_scale_approximation (jrm_matched.py) stays separately labelled and is never presented as exact JRM
